# Shape-Memory Alloy Recycling Process

A method for recycling products using shape-memory alloys to disassemble components for reuse or disposal.

The product is made with shape-memory alloy components that allow for disassembly without manual intervention. The alloy enables the product to self-destruct when exposed to heat, allowing for the separation of components. These components can then be reused, recycled, or disposed of as scrap metal. The process involves using shape-memory alloys to break down the product, with some parts being reusable and others being discarded. The company is responsible for ensuring that a percentage of the products are disposed of properly, though not all products will follow this process. The process is considered labor-intensive and requires high-quality machinery, but it offers an environmentally friendly approach to product disposal.
